# Regression gate

<!-- Generated by scripts/run_regression_gate.py; do not edit by hand. -->

The 71 contract-benchmark cases read as a pull-request gate. The contract was pinned when the fixed function landed. A later change either turns the function back into the buggy version (a regression the gate should block) or keeps the fix (a change the gate should let through). An unresolved answer sends the change to a human. Values are medians over runs, with the range in brackets; see [RESULTS.md](RESULTS.md) for the per-case answers.

| Gate | Model | Runs | Regressions blocked | Regressions let through | Regressions unresolved | Good changes blocked | Good changes unresolved | Flaky cases | Model cost per gate pass |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| mumei (hand-written ports) | — | 1 | 71 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | — | $0 (no model) |
| mumei + LLM port | openai/gpt-6-luna | 3 | 62 (59–62) | 8 (7–10) | 2 (1–2) | 2 (2–3) | 2 (1–2) | 10 | $0.05 |
| LLM review | openai/gpt-6-luna | 3 | 71 (70–71) | 0 (0–1) | 0 | 5 (4–5) | 0 | 6 | $0.04 |

How to read it:

- **mumei (hand-written ports)** is the gate once a port exists for the function. The ports were written with knowledge of the defects, so this row shows what the pinned contracts can enforce, not detection. mumei is deterministic, so one run is enough; a block comes with a counterexample and a pass with a proof certificate.
- **mumei + LLM port** is the gate without hand-written ports. The LLM only writes the `.mm` body of the changed function; mumei decides. A regression let through here is a translation that dropped the defect, a flaky case is a port that differs between runs.
- **LLM review** answers holds/violated itself. A pass is the model's opinion, not a proof, and the same change can get a different answer on another run.

Flaky under mumei + LLM port: `GO01-D02`, `GO02-D02`, `PY02-D05`, `PY03-D05`, `RS01-D03`, `RS01-D06`, `RS01-D12`, `SOL01-D08`, `TS01-D07`, `TS03-D09`.

Flaky under LLM review: `GO02-D03`, `GO03-D06`, `GO03-D07`, `PY03-D05`, `RS03-D08`, `TS01-D12`.

## Beyond the planted defect

[MUTATION.md](MUTATION.md) makes first-order mutants of the fixed ports (relational, logical, arithmetic and constant changes) and verifies them under the pinned contracts. mumei blocks 154 of 341 scored mutants (45%); 187 pass, either because the contract does not constrain that part of the body or because the mutant is equivalent. 0 do not verify either way. A pinned contract only gates what it states: the planted-defect rows above are an upper bound for an arbitrary later change.
